verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents a public GraphQL Developer API. It is authenticated by API key, supports schema introspection covering queries and mutations, and ships a browser-based API Playground plus API reference pages such as Framework Health & Vendor Data APIs and custom-integration push APIs. That clearly lets a programmatic or agent client drive the product. Missing for 10: a downloadable OpenAPI/Postman schema artifact (the probe found every OpenAPI path returns 404 and introspection is key-gated), documented breadth showing which product functions mutations cover, and independent hands-on corroboration that the API runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Introspection allows the API to describe its schema, including available queries, mutations, and response types.
